pattern: に足る / に足りる（にたる / にたりる）
purpose: Say that someone or something merits trust or consideration.
keywords: V dictionary / N + に足る / に足りる
He is a person worthy of trust.
We have gathered evidence worthy of examination.
This is a work worth preserving for future generations.
formation: V dictionary / N + に足る / に足りる
restrictions: Common with 信頼, 尊敬, and 検討.
mistake: 足る here is a worthiness judgment, not simply having enough objects.
